recipe.visualDefinition: A painterly composition featuring a bouquet of vibrant yellow and red flowers scattered across a textured, earth-toned background with sweeping, expressive brushstrokes in shades of ochre, sienna, and deep brown. The typography is elegant and classical, positioned at the top with high contrast.
coreVisualRelationships: The organic, chaotic arrangement of flowers contrasts with the structured, linear typography.
Warm, glowing highlights in the center background draw focus to the floral stems.
The deep brown shadows at the edges frame the central brighter ochre tones.
The thin, elegant serif typeface mirrors the delicate nature of the flower stems.
coreInvariants: A warm, earthy color palette dominated by sienna and ochre.
Visible, directional brushstrokes creating a sense of movement.
Classical serif typography with high stroke contrast.
Scattered floral elements rather than a tight bouquet.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main floral cluster is in the lower right quadrant, with individual petals and stems trailing toward the upper left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow flower heads in the lower center act as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal sweep of the background brushstrokes from top-right to bottom-left, punctuated by the scattered petals.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper central area provides a textured 'breathing room' for the main title text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the flowers against a muted, low-value earthy background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues or greens; maintain a strictly warm, autumnal temperature.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines.
Small caps used for secondary information.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' has a graceful, slightly curved leg.

composition.relationshipToImage: Lower opacity or tinted to blend with background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family using weight and tracking variations for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sharp serifs and elegant, classical proportions.
Captures the Roman monumental feel of the all-caps display.
Provides the necessary old-style warmth and readability.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an impressionist oil painting background with thick, diagonal brushstrokes in sienna, ochre, and dark brown. In the lower right, place a scattered bouquet of yellow and red poppies with long, thin green stems trailing across the canvas. Ensure the upper third has a smoother texture for text placement.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the primary title in a white, high-contrast classical serif font at the top left. Below it, add the secondary title in the same font family, using a slightly smaller size, wider tracking, and a light tan color to blend with the background.

verificationChecks: Is the typography left-aligned and all-caps?
Does the background feel like a physical painting with visible texture?
Are the colors strictly in the warm/earthy spectrum?
Is there a clear diagonal flow from bottom-right to top-left?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the background brushstroke texture
Saturation of the red floral accents
mustRedesign: Avoid any modern sans-serif or script fonts.
Do not use photographic realism; maintain the painterly, expressive style.
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible against the textured background.
Ensure the flowers look integrated into the paint, not just pasted on top.
Verify the tracking on the second line is noticeably wider than the first.
Confirm the color palette remains cohesive and warm.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a textured, earthy impressionist painting with high-contrast, wide-tracked classical serif typography for a sophisticated, organic aesthetic.
